confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a mid-sized regional NSW coastal city, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain; accommodation anchors are less certain and vary by beachfront location and weekday. July is winter, so hotel rates are set for a shoulder-season stay. The FX observation came from search-result summaries that attribute the 15 Oct 2026 rate to the RBA overview page. I did not read that page directly. A 16 Oct 2026 figure of 0.6947 from a third-party site was not verified against the RBA and was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a regional Australian coastal city, somewhat below Sydney and in the range of Newcastle NSW and Geelong. Restaurant and bar anchors reflect Australian cafe, pub and restaurant norms. Accommodation reflects the lower-cost tier of the Sydney-south coast market.
